title: Keyboard shortcuts
description: Shortcuts are ignored while you're typing in a field.

toggle-shortcuts.label: Keyboard shortcuts
toggle-shortcuts.description: Open or close this cheat sheet

escape.label: Close / unfocus
escape.description: Close a dialog, or unfocus the current input

focus-search.label: Focus search
focus-search.description: Jump to the scripture search input

book-search-navigate.label: Navigate verses
book-search-navigate.description: Move the selected verse in book search

book-search-chapter.label: Step chapter
book-search-chapter.description: Previous or next chapter in book search

schedule-next.label: Next schedule item
schedule-next.description: Stage the next item into Program preview

schedule-prev.label: Previous schedule item
schedule-prev.description: Stage the previous item into Program preview

schedule-go-to-current.label: Go to current item
schedule-go-to-current.description: Reveal and highlight the current item on the schedule

schedule-step-items.label: Step schedule items
schedule-step-items.description: Previous or next item when the schedule is focused

schedule-step-deck.label: Step within a group
schedule-step-deck.description: Move through the slides or verses of a grouped item

live-go.label: Stage then go live
live-go.description: First press stages the verse; second sends it to the audience

live-verse-page.label: Verse page
live-verse-page.description: Previous or next page of a long paginated verse

live-blackout.label: Blackout
live-blackout.description: Cut the audience output to black

live-clear.label: Clear text
live-clear.description: Hide the foreground text; keep the background

editor-delete.label: Delete element
editor-delete.description: Remove the selected element in the slide editor

editor-undo.label: Undo
editor-undo.description: Undo the last edit in the slide editor

editor-redo.label: Redo
editor-redo.description: Redo the last undone edit in the slide editor
